label: RUN 6 - multi-seed Vina ensemble sampling diagnostic (DIAGNOSTIC, NOT A HEADLINE)
notAHeadline: DIAGNOSTIC. This run does NOT produce a new headline. The preregistered headline stays run 3's 46/85 top-1 until a separately frozen full run replaces it. No ranking change is made here.

engine.successCriterion: RMSD < 2.0 A, symmetry-aware heavy-atom RDKit CalcRMS, no superposition

preparation.base: the preregistered run-3 preparation, imported unchanged
preparation.phase2Rule1: covalently linked multi-residue ligands are absorbed into the ligand using element covalent radii plus 0.40 A, excluding water, single-atom metal ions, the additive list and residues the cofactor rule already keeps; over the 85 this changes 1GKC only (10 -> 22 heavy atoms)
preparation.phase2Rule2: chemically modified amino-acid residues that are peptide-bonded into the chain are typed from the wwPDB CCD with polymer leaving atoms removed and kept as part of the rigid receptor; over the 85 this changes 1HVY, 1JLA, 1MEH, 1XM6
preparation.phase2Rule3: none — the protonation and histidine audit found no defect and nothing was implemented

engine.perTargetTuning: none - identical preparation, box, exhaustiveness, num_modes, energy_range and seed list for every case

pooling.method: pool all poses from all 5 seeds per case, then deduplicate deterministically
pooling.dedup: two poses are the same if their symmetry-aware heavy-atom RMSD to each other is below 1.0 A, matching Vina's own min_rmsd; the survivor is the one with the better Vina score, ties broken by (seed index, rank) ascending
pooling.ordering: the pooled pose list is ordered by Vina score ascending, ties broken by (seed index, rank) ascending
pooling.retained: the top 20 pooled poses define the top-K windows, so the ceiling is comparable to run 4's top-20; the full deduplicated pool is also reported separately as bestAvailable

samplingCeiling.definition: cases with any pose under 2.0 A anywhere in the deduplicated pool

rawUnionCeiling.definition: cases with any pose under 2.0 A anywhere in the RAW union of all 5 x 20 poses, before the frozen deduplication
rawUnionCeiling.note: SECONDARY, not the frozen metric. The preregistered ceiling is defined on the deduplicated pool and that is the headline number. This is reported because deduplication can drop a sub-2.0 A pose in favour of a better-scoring pose within 1.0 A of it, and the size of that effect should not be hidden.

top1MovementVsRun4.note: context only. This run makes NO ranking change and does NOT restate the preregistered 46/85 headline; the pooled top-1 is simply what Vina's own score picks out of a five-times-larger candidate set.

perSeedSingleSeedTop1.note: each number is the top-1 of ONE seed's own 20-mode run; this is the stochastic error bar on the preregistered 46/85 single-seed headline, which it does not replace

seed42AgreesWithRun4.note: seed 42 is run 4's seed. On cases the phase-2 rules do not touch, the pose set must be bit-identical to run 4; any case listed under unchangedCasesNotReproducingRun4 would be an unexplained drift and is reported rather than smoothed over.

poseOutput.note: plain files on disk; no zip or tar archive was created

deterministicReplay.note: an independent second execution of one frozen seed in a fresh working directory, compared bit for bit against the main run's recorded pose set
